why: The human ROP-staging literature reports UNWEIGHTED kappa; quadratic weighting inflates ordinal agreement because most errors are adjacent. Reporting only QWK makes our numbers incomparable to the only benchmark that matters.

sources: Gschliesser et al., Am J Ophthalmol 2015;160(3):553-560 (PMID 26004406)

not_a_superiority_claim: Fleiss kappa among 7 mutually-disagreeing experts is a different quantity from Cohen kappa between one model and one institution's coding practice. We report both to show the reference standard is a moving target, never to claim superhuman agreement.
